mapper.select: SELECT rv.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, u.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, tp.TITLE AS placeTitle, rv.CONTENT AS content, rv.REVIEW_IMAGE AS reviewImage, rv.REVIEW_ACTIVE AS reviewActive, rv.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REVIEW rv JOIN USERS u ON rv.USER_ID = u.NO JOIN TOUR_PLACE tp ON rv.CONTENT_ID = tp.CONTENT_ID ORDER BY rv.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT rv.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, rv.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, u.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, tp.TITLE AS placeTitle, rv.CONTENT AS content, rv.REVIEW_IMAGE AS reviewImage, rv.REVIEW_ACTIVE AS reviewActive, rv.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REVIEW rv JOIN USERS u ON rv.USER_ID = u.NO JOIN TOUR_PLACE tp ON rv.CONTENT_ID = tp.CONTENT_ID WHERE rv.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
